# AnxietyCentre.com

> A comprehensive mental health resource center connecting individuals with certified anxiety disorder therapists and treatment specialists.

AnxietyCentre.com provides access to a network of CCPA-certified therapists specializing in anxiety disorders, depression, PTSD, and related mental health conditions. The site features detailed therapist profiles, team information, and professional mental health services focused on evidence-based anxiety treatment approaches.

## Key Topics

- Anxiety Disorders
- Generalized Anxiety Disorder (GAD)
- Social Anxiety Disorder (SAD)
- Panic Disorder
- PTSD and Trauma
- Cognitive-Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Clinical Counseling
- Psychotherapy
- CCPA Certification
- Therapist Directory
- Mental Health Services
- Depression Treatment
- Family Therapy
- Professional Therapists
- Anxiety Treatment

## Therapist Directory

- [Therapists Archive](https://www.anxietycentre.com/therapists): Directory of anxiety disorder therapists including Stacey Ellertson, Phillip Henein, Johan Janse van Rensburg, and Chris Papastamos.
- [Stacey Ellertson](https://www.anxietycentre.com/therapists/stacey-ellertson): Profile of CCPA-certified therapist Stacey Ellertson specializing in anxiety, depression, and family therapy.
- [Phillip Henein](https://www.anxietycentre.com/therapists/phillip-henein): Profile of anxiety disorder therapist Phillip Henein specializing in GAD, panic disorder, and PTSD treatment.
- [Johan Janse van Rensburg](https://www.anxietycentre.com/therapists/johan-jvr): Profile of therapist Johan Janse van Rensburg specializing in GAD, social anxiety, and trauma/PTSD.
- [Chris Papastamos](https://www.anxietycentre.com/therapists/chris-papastamos): Profile of therapist Chris Papastamos specializing in GAD, SAD, panic disorder, and trauma therapy.
